description: This PHP class 'FormattedNumber' provides methods for detecting and converting formatted numeric strings into numeric types. It handles fractions, percentages, currencies, and plain numbers, applying specific regular expressions and calculations.

classes.name: FormattedNumber
classes.description: A utility class for parsing and converting various formatted number strings into numeric values.

methods.name: convertToNumberIfFormatted
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains a formatted number and converts it to a numeric value if applicable.

methods.name: convertToNumberIfNumeric
methods.description: Converts a plain numeric string to a float, considering locale-specific separators.

methods.name: convertToNumberIfFraction
methods.description: Detects fractional strings (e.g., '1/2') and converts them to numeric by evaluating the fraction.

methods.name: convertToNumberIfPercent
methods.description: Detects percentage strings and converts them to a decimal numeric value.

methods.name: convertToNumberIfCurrency
methods.description: Identifies currency-formatted strings and converts them to numeric values.

methods.name: currencyMatcherRegexp
methods.description: Generates a regex pattern to match currency-formatted strings based on locale settings.
